title: Round robin with a disk
summary: A quantum, a queue, and processes that leave for the disk before their quantum ends.
hints: A process whose burst ends before the quantum does goes to the disk (or terminates): it is not put back in the queue.
Reset the quantum every time a process is put in the ready queue.
When a process has used the whole quantum but its burst ends at that very instant, the burst ending wins: it goes to the disk and is not preempted.
